marta: quick heads-up — compact insights panel: keyboard tabbing + VoiceOver feels off on macOS. jumps over selected pill sometimes. sam_g: repro'd it. when panel opens focus lands on the header, then a tab skips down to the footer actions, skipping the filter chips. oliver_r: checked contrast for the selected pill: text #0B1F3A on bg #E8F0FF is ~3.6:1. w3c wants 4.5:1 for normal text. low contrast will make VO unclear for some users. priya: VoiceOver isn't announcing "selected" either. I think we don't set aria-pressed or aria-current on the chips. currently they're just buttons with a visual selected state. aria-bot: auto-a11y-scan completed for compact-insights (build/2026-03-22): failures: 3 (contrast, focus-order, missing aria-state) — report: https://ci.internal/reports/insights/1817509999 marta: proposal: 1) ensure initial focus goes to first interactive chip when panel opens (focus trap-ish) 2) add aria-pressed and aria-current where applicable 3) bump contrast or change selected text color to #062C62 (estim contrast 4.8:1) sam_g: agreed. repro steps I used: ``` 1) login as test@redwood 2) Open console -> Insights -> click compact view 3) press Tab (VoiceOver on) 4) Observe skip to footer ``` sam_g: adding note — this only happens when the panel is opened with a mouse click. keyboard-opened panel (Enter) works okay. oliver_r: small CSS patch that might help: ``` .chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0B3B82; outline-offset: 2px; } .chip[selected] { color: #062C62; background: #E8F0FF; } ``` priya: for ARIA I suggest: - role="button" aria-pressed="true|false" aria-current="true" on selected chip - live region for count changes:
Filters applied: 2
marta: question: do we want to make the chips act like toggle buttons (aria-pressed) or listbox with aria-selected? either is fine but semantics differ. sam_g: toggle button seems simpler for now; we rarely have single-select behavior here. priya: toggle is fine. add keyboard handler for Space/Enter and ensure we call event.preventDefault() to avoid double activation. marta: i'll open a ticket and drop the design decision + patch. JIRA: https://boards.redwood/INS-4125 — assign to @oliver_r, milestone next sprint. oliver_r: 👍 will pick it up. will include the CSS and aria changes and add small unit tests for keyboard focus order. aria-bot: created INS-4125 and linked CI scan. ETA est: 3 days. marta: thanks all. follow-ups: please add a tiny screenshot of VoiceOver rotor state if you hit oddness. :thumbsup: sam_g: will add logs and screencap. done. priya: noted accessibility acceptance criteria in the ticket. oliver_r: pushing small branch later today, will ping here when ready for review. marta: sounds good, closing thread for now. :sparkles:
